intent: Extend CAP-0007's existing epistemic-trajectory composition with one optional bounded Judgment-context phase that invokes CAP-0004's already-existing grounded rationale/revision persistence executor after Judgment persistence and before Outcome evaluation. The orchestrator must validate the CAP-0004 receipt but must not reimplement Judgment relation semantics. This extension is required by the storage-semiconductor later-vintage run so a later SK hynix Judgment can be related to the earlier 2022 guidance in the same fresh PostgreSQL execution.
rationale: CAP-0004 already owns and implements grounded Judgment rationale/revision relations in judgment_context_projection.py and execute_grounded_judgment_context.py. CAP-0007 already states that a bounded phase may be added when another capability owns the phase semantics. The observed research gap is composition only: ephemeral broker runs must recreate earlier and later Judgments together, then persist a real revision-family relation before Outcome/replay. A campaign-specific workaround or duplicate relation implementation would violate CAP-0007/RI-0006 ownership rules.
unmet_requirement: EpistemicTrajectorySpec cannot currently invoke the existing CAP-0004 Judgment-context executor, so an otherwise representable later-vintage revision relation cannot be included in one generic fresh-PostgreSQL trajectory.
